fields.label: Prompts
fields.placeholder: generate an image that: a wizard in a blue robe casting a fire spell
examples: generate an image that: a wizard in a blue robe casting a fire spell
generate an image that: the same wizard riding a red dragon over a burning castle
fields.help: One prompt per image, added in order and sent to a single chat session, so the character and style carry across every answer — write the second as a change to the first ("the same wizard, now …"). Short English prompts work best.

fields.label: Session ID
fields.help: Existing chat session to continue (from a previous run's session_id output). Omit to start a new chat.

fields.label: Response Mode
fields.help: image mode waits for generated images and downloads them to downloadDir.

fields.label: Max Wait (seconds)
fields.help: Maximum time to wait for each response in the loop.

fields.label: Download Directory
fields.help: Where to save generated images (image mode only).
